title: Boot UI: the first-launch engine setup screen gets a real theme
description: SetupView (shown while SetupCoordinator downloads/extracts the Sikarugir engine on a brand-new install - the literal first thing a new user sees) previously used zero skin theming at all - plain system chrome while the rest of the app is richly per-skin themed. Adds a real SkinBackground behind it, reading the already-saved (or default) skin, since the skin-picker wizard hasn't run yet at this point in the flow.
commit_message: Add SkinBackground to the boot/setup screen
